mechanism: A completed one-hour close consumes a frozen prior-96-hour external boundary, then the first later completed close back inside that same boundary identifies failed acceptance and trapped initiative inventory.

event.signal: completed 1h close outside prior 96 completed-hour high/low
event.episode: one non-overlapping excursion per symbol until first reclaim of the original frozen boundary
event.reclaim: first later completed 1h close back inside the original frozen boundary
event.invalid_before_entry: frozen opposite 96h boundary consumed before reclaim or target already crossed at executable entry

actions.entry: fixed 500ms after reclaim availability; conservatively first strictly later observable 1m open
actions.stop: one basis point beyond maximum causal excursion from signal through reclaim
actions.state_loss: later completed 1h close again outside the original failed boundary, executed at first later 1m open

chronology.stage_boundary: mark only; never strategy-close; unresolved outcomes do not become later-stage labels

ml_authorization: Only if one unchanged structural action is positive at 18/24bp with usable breadth and remains positive after exact positive-winner deletion and full slot rerouting in both 2022 and 2023.
prohibitions: no change to 96h scale, reclaim definition, target, stop, latency, cost, risk, leverage, symbol or side after outcomes
no ML rescue of a negative or concentrated base mechanism
no official 2024-2026 opening after base failure
